# Taxation of the business and its stakeholders {#sec-blp-taxation}

> *Assessment objective 5: taxation of a business and its stakeholders.*

::: {.callout-note title="Not yet written"}
Outline below. This is the most underestimated chapter in the subject.
:::

## Planned contents

**Income tax** — chargeable persons; the basis of charge; computing taxable income; rates and
allowances; anti-avoidance.

**Capital gains tax** — chargeable persons and chargeable disposals; computing the gain; the
principal reliefs, in particular business asset disposal relief, rollover relief and holdover
relief; collection.

**Corporation tax** — the basis of charge; computing taxable total profits as income profits plus
chargeable gains; allowable deductions; the main reliefs and exemptions; distributions;
anti-avoidance. *The September 2026 specification expands the wording here — expect it to be tested.*

**Value added tax** — the scope of the charge; registration; output and input tax; taxable, exempt
and zero-rated supplies; invoicing, returns and records.

**Inheritance tax** — business property relief as it applies to business assets.

::: {.callout-caution title="Rates and thresholds"}
Tax rates, bands and thresholds change annually and are the single most perishable content in this
text. Every figure in this chapter must be checked against the position at your sitting's examinable
law cut-off — see @sec-cutoff. Learn the *mechanics* from this text and the *numbers* from a current
source.
:::
